en.name: Crye Precision JPC Plate Carrier (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
en.description: The widely beloved Jumpable Plate Carrier (JPC) was designed to maximize operator mobility by reducing weight and bulk. Its modular system allows for personalized loadouts and quick gear adjustments depending on the mission. Manufactured by Crye Precision. USEC Intelligence Support Bureau version.

po.name: Crye Precision JPC Plate Carrier (USEC Intelligence Support Bureau)
po.description: O popular Jumpable Plate Carrier (JPC) foi projetado para maximizar a mobilidade do operador, reduzindo o peso e o volume. Seu sistema modular permite configurações personalizadas e ajustes rápidos do equipamento conforme a missão. Fabricado pela Crye Precision. Versão com pintura USEC Intelligence Support Bureau.
